closures: Reserva Natural Privada La Chorrera–Manchón Guamuchal: The registry lists Monday-Sunday as 'Acceso Libre' without clock hours. This is not interpreted as free admission, 24-hour opening or permission from its private administrator. Confirm visit arrangements; CONAP recommends arranging kayaking/birdwatching through tourism operators.

culture-cycles.note: Named-site registry calendar only, not a departmental public holiday or guaranteed live gate/volcanic-access status. No fee, unrestricted-access or guide-compulsion inference from generic recommendations.
